scripts.up: node scripts/localSecrets.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env --env-file docker/.env.local up -d --build
scripts.up:dev: node scripts/localSecrets.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env --env-file docker/.env.local up -d
scripts.down: node scripts/localSecrets.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env --env-file docker/.env.local down
scripts.logs: node scripts/localSecrets.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env --env-file docker/.env.local logs -f api worker
scripts.logs:vps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.vps.yml --env-file .env logs -f api worker
